title: Someone Was Impersonating Her in Online Affairs. She Says It Was Her Husband.

reading.body:
This incident describes identity impersonation conducted through online platforms, in which a person or persons used Collien Fernandes's name, image, and identity to conduct sexual affairs with other men, distribute explicit material attributed to her, and collect money from victims under false pretenses. The failure here is not one of an AI system but of online platform environments that permitted sustained, financially motivated impersonation to operate for years without detection or removal.

The impersonation was not caught by any platform mechanism and came to light only because Fernandes herself undertook a journalistic-style investigation after discovering a fake sex video in 2021. That timeline indicates that whatever moderation or identity-protection systems were in place on the relevant platforms were insufficient to detect or stop the conduct.

What is not established is whether the person Fernandes identified as responsible has been found liable in any legal proceeding, and her allegation that her husband was involved is a personal claim, not a confirmed finding.

summary:
# Summary

German actress and television personality Collien Fernandes discovered that someone had been impersonating her online for years, conducting sexual affairs with men using her name and identity. The impersonator created and shared explicit material purporting to show her and charged men money for promised access to her. After learning about a fake sex video featuring her in 2021, Fernandes decided to investigate her harassers like a journalist rather than ignore them. By late March, after considerable investigation, she believed she had identified one of the impersonators and prepared to expose him.

Fernandes had recently divorced Christian Ulmen, a famous German actor and comedian known for his cringe humor. During their 14-year marriage, the couple presented themselves as a modern, feminist partnership that challenged gender roles through her children's books and documentary work. However, their high-profile status also exposed Fernandes to invasive media attention and persistent online harassment that extended far beyond typical celebrity criticism into identity theft and explicit content creation.
